subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Can a Feishu/Lark-capable maintainer run live WebSocket diagnostics for this exact `im.message.receive_v1` missing-event symptom before a repair PR is queued?
rationale: Source and SDK contract inspection confirm the intended handler path exists, but the issue is a live delivery failure and cannot be safely fixed from source wiring alone.

options.title: Run live diagnostics first
options.body: Use maintainer Feishu credentials to capture redacted gateway and SDK logs across connection, lifecycle event, message event, parser, and routing boundaries before choosing a fix.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until the reporter can add logs or a recording that shows whether Feishu sends the message event to the SDK.

options.title: Merge into broader inbound triage
options.body: Treat this as part of the wider Feishu inbound cluster only if live proof shows the same root cause as an existing open issue or PR.

recommendation.title: Run live diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Use maintainer Feishu credentials to capture redacted gateway and SDK logs across connection, lifecycle event, message event, parser, and routing boundaries before choosing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the community maintainer for the Feishu/Lark plugin, which is the most direct routing signal for live Feishu behavior.
